`jsmn.h` is the header from [zserge/jsmn](https://github.com/zserge/jsmn),
commit `25647e692c7906b96ffd2b05ca54c097948e879c` (MIT; license in the header).
Only trailing whitespace has been normalized.
It tokenizes native Linux helper requests and legacy lease records so field
lookup stays within JSON object boundaries. It is compiled into the static
helper and adds no remote runtime dependency.
